'''Gangland''' was a plaza located in [[Black Sun territory]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate had a heavy presence in the plaza, and members often amused themselves by playing a game of "Boom"&mdash;planting explosives in crates of supplies and watching refugees blow themselves up in an attempt to retrieve them. Around [[3643 BBY]], a Republic-allied individual aided [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Theraguin]] in disabling the detonators and putting a stop to the game.
